record_notes.DCP-LETT-2150: October 3, supplied 1857; all seven body blocks, three notes and bibliography read. Explicitly acknowledges Huxley answer despite having expected none. Darwin accepts the Cuvierian descriptive task but argues that a further natural-system element is genealogical. P3–5 human-race descent case is expressly theoretical, with perfect knowledge stipulated, not a historical demonstration or claimed completed pedigree. P7 embryological argument is a fresh elaboration tied to the classification debate. Later Origin quotation is apparatus, not a current finished text.

These page references are not new letters or dates. Text uncertainty and conjectural enclosure association preclude treating the entire proof as a supplied incoming conversation.
